navy.use: Dominant — titles, dark fills, primary bars

light_blue.use: Cards, secondary highlights, second chart series

accent_blue.use: Accent words, callouts, section labels, links

pale_blue.use: Soft fills, icon backgrounds, third chart series

off_white.use: Alternate background, callout boxes, table row banding

rag.note: RAG status colours are the only permitted exception to the eight-colour palette, used for status cells only

fonts.headline: Newsreader (bold for the statement, italic for the accent word)
fonts.body: IBM Plex Sans (regular 14–16pt body; tables, captions, footers)
